i_would_like.definition: A warm way to say what you want. It is like saying I want, but kinder.
i_would_like.example: I would like some orange juice, please.

kpar_context.definition: The situation around a fact that decides what the fact means.
kpar_context.example: In the context of a night shift, that warning means something different.

leash.definition: A strap you hold when you walk a dog, so the dog stays safe near traffic.
leash.example: I hold the leash tightly at the crossing.

real_income.definition: Income adjusted for inflation, which is the figure that says how much you can actually buy.
real_income.example: Real income fell two per cent because prices rose faster than my pay.

shelf.definition: A flat board on the wall where you keep books and other things.
shelf.example: There are six books on the shelf.
